title: Great experience for end of the day
text: Great to have a massage after 4 hours at Alhambra Palace.  Lovely staff!
author: llergl

title: An exceptional massage and 10/10 service
text:
A fantastic experience with Francesca and Andrei. We had a one-hour massage and were delighted. The service was excellent, they were very kind and attentive at all times, and the massage was very professional and of high quality.
Without a doubt, a totally recommended place. We will definitely repeat!
author: 74natividadr

title: Highly recommended 100%
text: Highly recommended 100%. Facilities for booking. EXCELLENT service. The couple's massage is wonderful. The experience leaves a feeling of wanting to REPEAT.
author: Mónica R

title: Couple massage great!
text: Great massage! I would not hesitate to repeat when I return! Super helpful guys, attentive, polite and very good hands. We are very happy!!
author: Quest58224541257

title: A very complete and relaxing massage
text: We have gone for a couple massage and it has been super relaxing. The massage was an hour and full body from head to toe. The staff was very professional and we felt very welcome. We would love to repeat, it was a very good experience!
author: B7483SKlaurag

title: Total relaxation
text: My partner and I went to enjoy our daughter’s gift and came out completely new. Vanessa has hands that heal for real. We thank you very much for adjusting to the time wasting as we were late and yet you were wonderful and understanding. It was a fabulous choice, thank you very much team
author: A4083DProsanad

title: Excellent
text: A very good experience, me and my partner hired a massage for both of us for 1 hour, and we were both satisfied. Highly recommended.
author: Francisco G

title: Experience of 10
text: An experience of 10. Friendliness, Professionalism and Perfect Mood. Yolanda and José Luis, thank you for this very nice Service. To come back.
author: T6224KBanah

title: We have repeated and will continue to do so
text: Super recommended, they adapt very well to the needs of each one. Very professional, we have already gone several times and have always been very satisfied.
author: elip837

title: Best massage in Granada
text: Professionals who make you feel at home. Nice to meet you. Highly recommended. It wasn’t the first time I’ve been and there are certainly many more.
author: Bolboretamalva
